core_meaning.short_meaning: Man of God, strength of God
core_meaning.primary_meaning: Gibril is a Hebrew-origin name meaning “Man of God, strength of God”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Hebrew word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Gibril corresponds to the Hebrew form جبريل (Hebrew גַּבְרִיאֵל (Gaḇrīʾēl) 'man of God, strength of God'). Its core sense is gabriel, the angel of revelation. Gibril is the Arabic form جبريل (Jibrīl) of the name of the archangel Gabriel, from Hebrew גַּבְרִיאֵל Gaḇrīʾēl ('man of God / strength of God'). In Islam Jibrīl is the angel of revelation and is named in the Qur'an (2:97, 2:98, 66:4). The linguistic origin of the name is Hebrew; the Arabic جبريل is its Qur'anic form. CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave غبريل (with غ, a different letter) — the correct form is جبريل.
